title: The Von-Neumann State-Space Transformer for neural decoding
abstract: arXiv:2608.25088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cortical computation is strikingly low-dimensional: a handful of latent variables, carried in a neural population's activity, steer the higher-dimensional responses of individual neurons. Our aim is sample efficiency-models that decode well from limited data and at small parameter budgets. In a standard Transformer layer, the feed-forward block applies the same operator to every token. We suggest a von-Neumann inspired hypothesis of efficient computation as an alternative for neural decoding: a controller decodes an instruction and then executes a token-specific operator; the usual realization-a soft mixture of experts-only blends their outputs, not operators. translated_title: 用于神经解码的冯·诺依曼状态空间Transformer
translated_abstract: 皮层计算具有显著的低维特性：少数潜在变量承载于神经群体活动中，引导着单个神经元的高维响应。我们的目标是样本效率——即在有限数据和较小参数预算下实现良好解码的模型。在标准Transformer层中，前馈块对每个token应用相同的算子。我们提出一个受冯·诺依曼启发的计算高效假设，作为神经解码的替代方案：控制器解码一条指令，然后执行一个特定于token的算子；通常的实现——专家混合的软组合——仅混合其输出，而非算子。我们引入了冯·诺依曼状态空间Transformer（VN-SST），一种记忆增强的Transformer，其前馈块是一个低秩指令库：一个共享的基础算子加上一小组合成的低秩指令，从中每个token的代码合成权重矩阵。
tldr: 本文提出VN-SST，一种基于冯·诺依曼架构的低秩指令库Transformer，通过为每个token合成特定算子，在有限数据和参数预算下提升神经解码的样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VN-SST, a von-Neumann-inspired Transformer with a low-rank instruction bank that synthesizes token-specific operators, improving sample efficiency for neural decoding under limited data and parameter budgets.
